messages:
alexa: Quick brain dump on DP prioritization: we need a repeatable rubric so we don't bias toward loudest customers.
max: yes — +1. what's the minimal scoring axes you want?
sanjay: propose 5 axes: compliance risk, integration effort, business impact, breadth (number of users/features), and observability fit. each 1-5.
lisa: ok but add strategic value (co-marketing / platform reference) as a bonus multiplier.
alexa: good call. I sketched a lightweight form: 5 numeric fields + a notes box + must-have flag. share informal example?
max: example please.
alexa: ```
- compliance_risk: 1-5 (5 = high risk/regulated)
- integration_effort: 1-5 (5 = deep engineering, >4w)
- business_impact: 1-5 (5 = revenue / retention delta)
- breadth: 1-5 (5 = many teams/large surface)
- observability_alignment: 1-5 (5 = uses our dashboards / tracing)
- strategic_bonus: 0/0.5/1.0 (co-marketing, reference)
- must_have: Y/N
- notes: free text
```
ritesh: For sales intake, can we map score -> rollout lane? e.g., 18+ = priority private preview, 12-17 = standard beta, <12 = nurture.
emily: That bucket mapping seems actionable. Also recommend a hard filter: if compliance_risk==5 require security review before any onboarding.
sanjay: Agree. Also suggest we weight integration_effort higher for roadmap planning (because big integrations can block capacity). So multiply integration_effort by 1.2 in the aggregate.
lisa: On incentives: keep tiered offers but make them deterministic by score band so reps can close faster.
ritesh: I'll take that. Sales needs a one-pager table: band -> pitch -> incentive -> expected commit. I'll populate with sample customers.
alexa: Great. Also capture expected timeline per band: priority (4 weeks total), standard beta (6 weeks), nurture (contact quarterly).
max: We should set clear success KPI per lane. Suggested KPIs: priority: weekly active users >= X or 10k queries/week, latency p95 < target, quality pass rate > 90%. standard: lower thresholds but still defined.
emily: Add a post-pilot review template: baseline metrics, change vs baseline, integration blockers, handoff notes, next steps.
sanjay: Important: scope guard rails. Add checkboxes in intake: "product changes required? (Y/N)", "will engineering accept bugfix-only scope?". Partners should understand pilots are not custom feature builds unless scored and budgeted.
lisa: I'll draft outreach that sets expectations up front: 3-week sandbox, 2-week monitoring, success review, optional extension. Keep messaging explicit about what we won't do in pilot.
ritesh: Contract ask: pilots <= $10k we do NDA + SOW-lite; anything beyond requires legal + purchasing. I'll flag when I add candidates.
ops-bot: [ticket created] #DP-427 DP prioritization rubric + intake form. assignees: lisa, ritesh, sanjay. ETA 3 business days. https://rwd.internal/tickets/DP-427 :white_check_mark:
alexa: Action list: lisa = outreach + banded incentive table (48h), sanjay = scoring weights & post-pilot review template (48h), max = KPI examples & runbook template (48h), ritesh = candidate list and initial banding (24h). We'll review Tue 9am PT.
emily: I'll add the security pre-check checklist for any compliance_risk >=4 cases.
max: small note: let's track pilot resource allocation in a shared sheet so infra knows expected GPU/time.
ritesh: adding that to my sales tracker and will sync.
alexa: Thanks all. If we get this live we can avoid ad-hoc promises and speed onboarding. :rocket:
